Risk · Anomaly detection

Fraud Protection

We worked on a way to surface suspicious patterns earlier and give fraud analysts enough context to decide what to investigate.

evoke · 2025

The problem

Fraud analysts often had to connect details from several systems after an event. By the time the pattern became clear, it could already have caused harm.

The decision

We focused on scoring and triage. The design needed to show why a case was flagged, give analysts enough context to investigate it and calibrate scores to avoid flooding the queue.

What the workflow supported

It helped analysts look for connected accounts, recognize unusual behavior and decide where to start. The analyst kept the final decision.
